material.acceptance_criteria: the mod-unit-map job prints mod-unit-map ok handle=<h> room=<id> from_x=<x> from_y=<y> to_x=<x> to_y=<y> with the coordinates differing, and fails when they are equal.
material.description: /state and /delta expose no per-unit position, so the mod-unit-map check infers a move from a state_hash change, and the before sample may already include the order. Serve the mapped unit's x and y on /state or /delta (a read-only field), then assert the mapped unit's x or y differs before and after the order.
material.resolution: Unit position served on /state?unit=<id> (unit object x,y or null). The mod-unit-map check reads the mapped unit before the order and after, and fails when the coordinates are equal. Note: /state now carries a unit key, null by default; additive.
material.subject: Serve unit position so a mapped order's move is proven, not inferred
